## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm audit --audit-level=high`
- [ ] `npm pack --dry-run`

## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request is linked to an issue.
- [ ] Tests cover behavior changes and failure paths.
- [ ] Public interface or behavior changes are documented in English, Korean, and Japanese.
- [ ] No credentials, secrets, private source code, or generated build artifacts are included.
- [ ] No real cloud build was submitted as part of automated testing.
